shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/providers/openai/openaiProvider.ts && rg -n 'specs/.*#' src | head -35 && cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100 && ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'spec:|@spec|specs/' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40; cat src/providers/bedrock/bedrockProvider.ts | head -70; cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -100"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('spec.md#1','spec.md#11').replace('expect({rejected, calls}).toEqual({\\n      rejected: failure,','expect({sameError: rejected === failure, calls}).toEqual({\\n      sameError: true,'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('## Measured semantics — out of scope','## Failure and usage semantics').replace('These three properties of "'`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` are recorded so the hook features that follow specify against real behaviour. PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'Define beforeSession failure acceptance' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
